summary: Multiple WebRTC-related changes around codec selection, capability checks, and stats. MediaCapabilities queries and encoding paths now flow through asynchronous codec support, GMP (Gecko Media Plugins) codec creation is gated on plugin availability, H.264 profile-level info is placed correctly into codec parameters, hardware H.264 decode is retained when no software decoder is present, and WebRTC now reports rtxSsrc and retransmission statistics. Together these make video calls more compatible and reliable and provide better diagnostics for call quality — **improved retransmission and recovery reporting for WebRTC**.
